label: Bible Study
prompt: Flee also _____ lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verse: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
note: Paul to Timothy — run from what drags you down, run toward what's right.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have _____ one to another.
verse: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
note: The world will know Jesus's disciples not by their badges but by how they love one another.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of _____,
verse: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
note: A nod to Daniel among Hebrews' heroes of faith: those who 'stopped the mouths of lions.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of _____, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verse: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
note: 'Abba' is Aramaic for father, the word Jesus himself prayed in Gethsemane — the Spirit teaches adopted kids the family word.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that _____ his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verse: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
note: Cover-up versus confession: hide your sins and you won't prosper; confess and forsake them and you'll find mercy.
